decisions.name: Event-Driven Architecture
decisions.rationale: To handle various events and messages from different components, ensuring scalability and reliability.

decisions.name: Message Queue
decisions.rationale: To handle message exchange between components, ensuring reliable and efficient communication.

decisions.name: Microservices
decisions.rationale: To enable the system to scale and handle failures independently.

decisions.name: API Gateway
decisions.rationale: To handle incoming requests and route them to the corresponding microservices.

decisions.name: Security
decisions.rationale: To ensure secure access to user data and system features.

decisions.name: Scalability
decisions.rationale: To handle increasing user demand and data volume.

decisions.name: Reliability
decisions.rationale: To ensure reliable operation and minimize downtime.

decisions.name: Maintainability
decisions.rationale: To enable easy maintenance and updates.

components.name: Lecture Processor
components.responsibility: Processes uploaded lectures for question generation

components.name: File Converter
components.responsibility: Converts uploaded files to text format

components.name: Text Extraction Module
components.responsibility: Extracts relevant text from uploaded files for question generation

components.name: Question Generator
components.responsibility: Generates questions based on extracted text and user input

components.name: Question Bank Manager
components.responsibility: Stores and manages generated questions for future use

components.name: Difficulty Level Service
components.responsibility: Allows users to select the difficulty level of generated questions

components.name: User Interface
components.responsibility: Provides a user-friendly interface for users to interact with the system

components.name: Question Bank Database
components.responsibility: Stores and manages generated questions in a database
